name: How long does new plumbing fixture installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does new plumbing fixture installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a new plumbing fixture installation depends on the type of fixture and the specifics of the job. Simple installations, like a standard faucet or toilet replacement, can often be completed within 1-3 hours. More complex projects, such as installing a new shower unit or a water heater, might take half a day or longer, especially if minor plumbing adjustments are required. Alpha-Plumbing Services aims to work efficiently to minimize disruption, and we'll provide an estimated timeframe during your consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies: simple fixtures take 1-3 hours, while complex ones like showers or water heaters may take half a day or more.
